headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...

headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: Morning market close July 30: ChiNext down over 6%, consumer stocks rally
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets oscillated and adjusted in the morning session, with three major indices falling collectively; STAR 50 fell over 6%. Consumer stocks like baijiu and food continued to rebound. Yiming Food hit its third consecutive daily limit up; Jinhui Liquor and Shede Spirits hit limit up. Banking sector strengthened against the trend; ICBC and CCB both hit record highs. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks declined, with Tongfu Microelectronics and Rockchip hitting limit down; Hua Hong Semiconductor and Cambricon fell over 10%. Hardware computing stocks fell, with CIG Cambridge and Dongshan Precision hitting limit down; Eoptolink, Zhongji Innolight, and TFC Communications fell over 10%. More stocks fell than rose, with over 3,400 stocks in the red across the three markets; morning session turnover was 1.46 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.15%, the Shenzhen Component fell 3.79%, and the ChiNext fell 5.89%. 2. Sector concepts: baijiu, auto OEM, tourism, education led the gains; semiconductors, CPO, memory chips, and glass led the declines.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: ChiNext opens low and falls 5.89%, AI hardware leads steep declines
headlines.summary_en: As of midday, Shanghai Composite fell 1.15%, Shenzhen Component fell 3.79%, ChiNext fell 5.89%, and Bei Zheng 50 fell 0.46%. Three-market turnover was 1.4627 trillion yuan, shrinking 26.9 billion yuan from the previous day. Over 3,400 stocks declined across the market. In terms of sectors, baijiu sector rose again; Golden Seed Liquor, Shede Spirits, and Jinhui Liquor hit limit up; Huangtai Liquor, Kouzijiao, Jiugui Liquor, Yingjia Gongjiu, and Yanghe shares followed. Education sector continued to rise; Chuanzhi Education hit four consecutive limit ups; Xueda Education hit limit up; Chuangye Heima, Angli Education, Huatu Shanding, Kaiwen Education, and Kede Education followed. Auto OEM sector performed strongly; Jianghuai Auto hit limit up; BAIC BluePark, Seres, Kinglong Auto, Qianli Keji, and Changan Auto followed. Electronic chemicals sector opened low and fell further; Tiantong Co. and Honghe Technology approached limit down; Sanfuxinke, Weiteou, Tiancheng Technology, and Guanggong Qi shares followed.
